instruction: Download the last Monday's weekly work meeting slides and recording from Gmail and save them in my file system as per the existing file structure and format.
notes: Current date is Friday 2023-05-19, so last Monday is 2023-05-15. The agent must learn both the existing file-system layout (file_system.show_directory, recursive) and the attachment ids of the Monday meeting email (gmail.show_inbox_threads with a query, then gmail.show_thread) before downloading each attachment with gmail.download_attachment into the matching path (download_to_file_path, using the file_system token). Static init facts encode which thread matches the query, which attachments belong to it, and the intended target path per attachment; (structure-known) gates downloads on having inspected the file system. Evaluation requires only added File/Directory records and no deleted attachments, which the download-only model respects. supervisor.complete_task takes the two attachments and their paths as record parameters (not API args) so its precondition mirrors the goal; the task asks no question so no answer is passed.
